bounded_observations: Phase breadcrumb harness proof, 2026-09-07
Scope: test-only extraction corpus evaluation harness. No corpus request, VM, benchmark, or comparative measurement was run for this change.

Opt-in control: ENTIRE_GRAPH_EXTRACTION_CORPUS_PHASE_BREADCRUMBS=1. When enabled, bounded NDJSON breadcrumbs are written to the inherited process stderr stream already captured by the coordinator. The default path is disabled and does not allocate a writer or acquire a callback mutex.

Bound: at most 64 records and 4096 bytes. Progress is reduced to phase start/end records with counters; 16 records and 1536 bytes are reserved for API, resolution, serialization, and artifact-write tail markers. RSS remains an external observation.
Focused verification:
go test ./internal/sem -run '^TestExtractionCorpus(PhaseBreadcrumb|Evaluation)' -count=1
go test -race ./internal/sem -run '^TestExtractionCorpusPhaseBreadcrumb' -count=1
git diff --check

The subprocess test emits ordinary stderr text, writes 10,000 parse progress events followed by a relations transition and terminal markers, is killed, and verifies the captured inherited stream retains both ordinary output and the bounded breadcrumb prefix.
